title: Inspect the kind of a value
summary: SQLite values have storage classes such as integer, real and text.
introduction: SQLite values have storage classes such as integer, real and text. Your task: Compare typeof(5) with typeof('5').
learningObjectives: Explain the example for inspect the kind of a value

blocks.text: SQLite values have storage classes such as integer, real and text. typeof reports the class of an expression.
Use the SQL Run button for examples marked runnable. They use this site's in-browser SQLite database and sample-only table names. A Python example needs Python on your own computer instead.

blocks.code: SELECT typeof(12) AS whole,typeof(2.5) AS decimal_kind,typeof('12') AS words;
blocks.title: Inspect the kind of a value

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: SQLite `typeof` reports the storage class of this expression, such as integer or text.
`SELECT` names the output values. `AS` can give a calculated result a readable column name.

blocks.text: The values are integer, real and text.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A text value that looks like a number is still text in this expression. SQLite column affinity adds further conversion rules.
